messages:
Ravi (Finance): billing-bot flagged a short but very expensive GPU burst in project 'partner-sandboxes' yesterday evening. link: https://redwood.app/billing/partner-sandboxes
billing-bot: ALERT: project=partner-sandboxes period=2026-05-02T18:00..20:00 gpu_cost=15,900usd delta=+420% vs baseline top_resources=[sandbox-12,sandbox-7]
Priya (FinOps): can we map resource->partner? need to know if partners should be credited or if this was internal test noise
Hannah (Cloud Ops): quick export shows two heavy runs from sandbox-12 and sandbox-7. both created by automation user `demo-runner` and missing owner tag. sample:
```
resource,project,cost_usd,labels
sandbox-12,partner-sandboxes,9,800,partner=partner-alpha;owner=
sandbox-7,partner-sandboxes,6,100,partner=;owner=
```
Priya (FinOps): partner-alpha appears on sandbox-12 so that partner might have been billed. sandbox-7 is unlabeled -> internal. recommend provisional credit to partner-alpha for $9,800 while we confirm with partner contact
Ravi (Finance): approve provisional credit up to $10k. Hannah, can you backfill owner tags for the unlabeled resources within 48h?
Hannah (Cloud Ops): running a 48h backfill now using provisioning logs. also adding a temporary budget throttle for partner-sandboxes. patch: https://git.redwood/cloud/changes/8120
billing-bot: NOTE: provisional_credit created amount=9800usd case=CR-2041 notify=[ravi@redwood.com,priya@redwood.com]
Priya (FinOps): will prepare final allocation after backfill. also proposing CI lint to prevent `demo-runner` from launching >4 GPUs in partner projects. filing follow-up ticket.
Ravi (Finance): thanks. we'll hold billing adjustment until partner confirms. closing loop after backfill. :white_check_mark:
